name: Spicy Thai prawn noodles
assumptions: Recipe serves 2 adults as a main dish based on 450g prawns and 200g noodles being typical for 2 portions
Preparation and cooking time estimated at 15 minutes from instructions (noodle cooking ~5 min + egg omelette ~3 min + stir-fry ~5-7 min)
Soy sauce assumed to contain wheat (standard unless specified gluten-free)
Fish allergen null as prawns are crustaceans (shellfish) and no fin fish present
Tree nuts null as peanuts are legumes and no tree nuts listed
Gluten-free null due to soy sauce typically containing wheat and lack of certification for noodles or other items
Pescatarian true as only seafood (prawns) is the animal product, compatible with eggs and no meat
Dairy-free true as no milk, cheese, or other dairy ingredients
instructions:
step 1
Cook the noodles following the pack instructions, drain and set aside for later. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and pour in the beaten egg. Swirl around the pan to make a thin omelette, cook for 1-2 mins, then flip over and cook the other side for 1 min. Tip out and slice into thin strips.

step 2
Add the chilli and ginger to the pan, fry for 1-2 mins then tip in the noodles, prawns and egg. Splash in the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 min more. Throw in the chopped herbs and pour over the lime juice and zest, then sprinkle over the chopped peanuts and serve.

ingredients.name: Rice Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Dry rice noodles as per pack; typical Asian rice stick noodle values used.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp sesame oil (14g); assumes all oil is used for cooking the egg.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large eggs beaten (~60g each); values for whole raw egg.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chili (~45g whole, chopped); typical fresh red chili values.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 3cm fresh ginger root (~15g peeled and chopped); typical fresh ginger values.

ingredients.name: Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: 450g raw peeled prawns (edible portion); typical cooked prawn values adjusted for raw weight context.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp soy sauce (~15g); typical regular soy sauce values.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bunch fresh coriander (~30g chopped leaves and stems); typical fresh cilantro values.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: Half a handful fresh mint (~15g leaves); typical fresh mint values.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Zest and juice of 1 lime (~60g total edible yield); typical lime values.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.assumptions: 1 handful roasted peanuts (~30g chopped); typical dry-roasted unsalted peanut values.
